title: Red Bean Pilaf with Roasted Vegetables
description: A flavorful and nutritious pilaf dish made with red beans, wholesome pilaf, and roasted roasted vegetables.

ingredients.name: roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots and bell peppers

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of salad oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the cooked juicy red bean and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the red bean paste and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the wholesome pilaf and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add the roasted vegetables and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, and sesame oil, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving dish and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped green onions or sesame seeds if desired.
